integration.note: Master integrated into the audit branch. No master merge or push is asserted. Raw reports retain failed attempts. The accepted native cloud matrix combines five unchanged passing probes from v2 with the three final probes from v3; the v2 invalid-shader guard is replayed by the verifier.

limits: Production smoke uses native headless Chrome/AMD ANGLE D3D11 at 1280x720 DPR1, MSAA8 and medium cloud quality. No new FPS or A/B timing claim.

Independent accepted SwiftShader checks cover output composition and cloud pipeline; they do not replace real hardware validation. The additional strict cloud-lighting parity attempt failed: the half-overflow fixture produces different NaN sign and finite velocity differs by one half-float ULP. This preexisting master packed-output path was not modified or its exact native test weakened; the failure remains an explicit portability limitation.
Known ANGLE X3595 planet derivative warnings remain open. Two X3206 cloud-noise warnings are isolated to driver-generated float4-to-scalar output conversion; exact logs and shader hashes are checked.
Seven existing unit skips and the existing Vite chunk-size warning remain. Other GPUs, 4K/DPR2, multi-system cloud flight benchmark and multi-hour runs are not included.
PNG screenshots and frozen production bundles remain local; their hashes are recorded. Embedded reports contain the functional assertions, not a production pixel-equivalence claim.
